difficulty.notes: Official Swedish/English pages say green difficulty. Official prose describes easy walking on paved and gravel roads plus a well-trodden path to Sandsjön shelter, with a slight uphill from Rydöbruk to Lahult.

routeType.type: point-to-point inland section / western Mellersta branch end
routeType.notes: Sixth researched section of Mellersta delleden/Central inland branch in the local M numbering. The current official GPX starts at Rydöbruk and ends at Kvarnforsen. It appears to close the western Mellersta branch: the physical onward Hallandsleden route from Kvarnforsen is Kvarnforsen - Gyltige on Södra delleden, while the Mellersta section list next-card points to non-contiguous Ästad - Vessigebro on the eastern branch.
routeType.descriptionForAppDraft: From Rydöbruk the trail crosses Klubbån and a drained canal, then follows paths, forest roads and small roads past the traces of Högdal/Högadahl, Lahult mill pond and the Lahult burial ground. It reaches the shelter at Sandsjön, continues past Gammalsbo and through a varied landscape of gravel roads, farms, conifer forest, marshy ground and lakes around Nordsjön, then ends at the Kvarnforsen shelter. The section is easy by Hallandsleden standards, but has repeated watercourse crossings, road walking, farm gates and access/parking caveats at Kvarnforsen.

Hylte contaminated-land page updated 2025-01-16 lists Gammalsbo AFA as risk class 1 and Rydöbruk AFA/industrial landfills as risk class 2. Add off-trail/foraging caution near old landfill/industrial areas; do not treat as a normal-walking restriction.

conditionReports.summary: Exact current full-section field-report coverage is thin. The best exact/overlapping evidence is a 2023 local walk around Sandsjön-Gammalsbo and older 2016 reports for old Kvarnforsen-Sandsjön and Sandsjön-Långesjön segmentation. No recent detailed full-M6 condition report or closure/reroute report was found.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Exact partial M6: Sandshult/Sandsjön to Gammalsbo and back along Hallandsleden.
findings: 28 walkers parked at Sandshult and followed Hallandsleden along Sandsjön to Gammalsbo before returning.
Report describes a good experience and mentions no issues with signage, mud, closures, bridges or access.
reports.conditionValue: Medium for Sandsjön-Gammalsbo partial corridor; not full M6.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Old/stale Kvarnforsen - Sandsjön substage, now part of M6.
findings: Route described as very easy, mostly fine forest road, a fairly long hill after about 1 km and a few hundred meters on asphalt.
Passes properties and Nordsjön.
Access by car to Sandsjön was awkward; road toward Gammalsbo led to private/unauthorized-access signage and loose-dog warning, so the party parked about 1.5 km away.
One car passed fast on the road.
reports.conditionValue: Medium for historical terrain/access context; low for current 2026 condition.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Exact partial M6 in reverse: Sandsjön to Rydöbruk, then adjacent M5 corridor.
findings: Starts from Sandsjön on gravel road, enters Rydöbruk by country road, passes houses/farms and no other hikers encountered.
Later notes about RV26, Karl XI spring and going wrong are on the adjacent Långesjön side, not M6.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Old combined Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen plus adjacent Gyltige, includes M6 middle/end but omits current Rydöbruk-Sandsjön start.
findings: 30.98 km one-way route, moderate, no comments or condition text.
reports.conditionValue: Low; confirms passage but no condition detail.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Old combined route including part of M6.
findings: 31.28 km one-way route, moderate, no condition notes.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Old combined route including part of M6.
findings: 20.1 mi route, one review shown but no review text exposed. Rated hard because it combines multiple stages; not evidence that M6 alone is hard.
Confirms passage through the old combined section; no condition issue stated.

reports.matchedSegmentation: Adjacent local Rydöbruk loop, not M6.
findings: 2025 reviews mention good/great conditions, free large parking, not crowded and some tarmac. Not transferable to M6 except near-start context.

terrain: Official page and old Kvarnforsen-Sandsjön report both support easy/green difficulty and forest/gravel/asphalt road character.
Route apps rate old combined Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige moderate/hard, but this should not be applied to M6 alone.
signageMaintenance: No exact M6-specific current signage problem found.
2016 access-to-Sandsjön issue involved private/unauthorized-access and loose-dog signs on a car approach, not necessarily Hallandsleden signage.
sheltersToiletsFirewood: Current official/Naturkartan evidence supports shelters/fireplaces/dry toilets/bins at Sandsjön and Kvarnforsen.
No recent exact field report on shelter/toilet/firewood state found.
waterMudFlooding: No exact M6 mud/flood report found.
Adjacent old Gyltige-Kvarnforsen storm/high-water/slippery-bridge notes were outside M6 and stale.
roadTraffic: 2016 old-stage report noted one fast-passing car; route includes asphalt/gravel roads and farm/property access.
currentClosures: No public indexed current closure/reroute note found for M6 in searched sources.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page/API says 10 km/10000 m; GPX desc is Total: 10.3 km and computed geometry 10.248 km; Naturkartan displays 10.4 km; Woods/Hylte page title says 11 km.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use official displayed 10 km for rounded section metadata; preserve GPX computed 10.248 km and Naturkartan/Woods variants in research notes.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not force geometry length to 10 km or import 11 km as canonical.

sourceContradictions.details: Current official GPX/API/Naturkartan starts at Rydöbruk 56.957390,13.142808 and ends at Kvarnforsen 56.894596,13.188851. API line.geometry and OSM relation preserve old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige linework starting at Sandsjön and continuing beyond Kvarnforsen.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical. Treat API line.geometry and OSM relation 5599309 as stale/secondary source-risk records.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige as current M6.

sourceContradictions.details: M6 same-track next card points to Ästad - Vessigebro on Mellersta delleden, which is not geographically continuous. Physical onward route from Kvarnforsen is Kvarnforsen - Gyltige on Södra delleden.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Model M6 as end of Mellersta western branch and physical handoff to Södra Kvarnforsen - Gyltige. Do not imply geographic continuity to Ästad - Vessigebro.

sourceContradictions.details: M5 sources include Lahult/Sandsjön/Kvarnforsen records/images, but M6 prose/API clearly assign them to M6.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Suppress Lahult/Flottningsrännan/Sandsjön/Kvarnforsen from M5 core and import under M6; share only Rydöbruk endpoint records where appropriate.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Avoid duplicate or wrong-section facility imports.

sourceContradictions.details: Section prose says shelters can accommodate 4-6 adults, while Sandsjön place/Woods text says 4-5 people.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use cautious capacity text or omit exact capacity in normalized data unless facility-specific source is chosen.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden drinking-water category returns zero for M6. Naturkartan says nearby landowner can provide drinking water/firewood/shower.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Treat Kvarnforsen water as conditional/private pending, not guaranteed public water.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import as public drinking-water source.

sourceContradictions.details: Knystaria appears in OSM or booking traces near the start, but current Knystaria site says closed.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Suppress Knystaria as active food/service unless a current reopening source appears.

researchIterations.approach: Six parallel research/report lanes plus main-thread official/API/GPX/Naturkartan/OSM/places/transit cross-checks. All lanes returned; no targeted second batch was needed because remaining gaps are import/currentness caveats rather than section-research blockers.
